Can't reach the community right now. Try: Jumuiya haipatikani kwa sasa. Jaribu tena baada ya dakika moja.
No account called {name} here can come b: Hakuna akaunti iitwayo {name} hapa inayoweza kurejeshwa kwa kuingia. Hakikisha umeandika jina lako lote, au tumia maneno yako 12.
The account that came back isn't {name},: Akaunti iliyorejeshwa si {name}, kwa hiyo hakuna kilichohifadhiwa kwenye simu hii. Jaribu tena, au tumia maneno yako 12.
{sent} sent. Not sent: {names}. Try agai: Mialiko iliyotumwa: {sent}. Haikutumwa kwa: {names}. Jaribu tena ukipata mtandao.
For your safety, getting back in with a: Kwa usalama wako, kurudi kwa kuingia huchukua siku moja. Ikiwa bado una simu nyingine yenye akaunti yako ya BeanPool, fungua BeanPool hapo na uguse "Yes, it's me" ili kuirejesha sasa. Ikiwa haikuwa wewe, simu hiyo inaweza kuisimamisha.
For your safety it takes a day, or less: Kwa usalama wako huchukua siku moja, au chini ya hapo ikiwa simu yako nyingine itathibitisha kuwa ni wewe.
